objective: Rank long-horizon, catalyst-backed GP parking opportunities separately from fast flips and evergreen mean reversion. Cash remains the benchmark and speculative positions are never mandatory.

policy.rule: Speculative parks require an explicit catalyst thesis, bounded sizing, patient entry, invalidation and acceptable RuneLite freshness/liquidity. They do not enter the normal capital frontier while allocation_authoritative=false. Only forward-looking, corroborated catalysts belong in the active list; resolved pre-release bets must be archived and re-underwritten with live combat data.
policy.note: Scenario probabilities are subjective research estimates, NOT calibrated forecast probabilities. No automatic purchasing; live execution, tax, account holdings and orders must be confirmed.

candidates.name: Arcane prayer scroll
candidates.thesis: Confirmed CoX supply-weight reduction creates recovery optionality, but demand weakness and inventory overhang remain real.
candidates.invalidation: Price fails to stabilize despite reduced supply or demand structurally weakens further.

candidates.name: Dexterous prayer scroll
candidates.thesis: Reduced CoX supply gives a recovery path, but current tape must demonstrate stabilization before meaningful allocation.
candidates.invalidation: Reduced supply does not overcome demand/inventory pressure or the scroll establishes a lower structural range.

candidates.name: Dragon hunter lance
candidates.thesis: The Spring 2027 Dungeons of Gielinor roadmap creates a future dragonbane discussion cycle. Not yet verified BIS; prefer patient entries and consider selling into announcement attention before launch.
candidates.invalidation: Encounter stats, monster classification, drops, profitable kill volume, or superior substitute weapons fail to support this combat style; sell-the-news or crowded community inventory swamps demand.
